description: Delete a campaign. IRREVERSIBLE — cascades to its pipeline stages, target/lead memberships, documents, scripts and other campaign-scoped rows (leads/contacts/accounts themselves are NOT deleted). Refuses if the campaign still has target members unless force=true. Reassign the ingest default_campaign_id first if this is the Beeper default.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign to delete

force.description: Delete even if the campaign has target members.

name: delete_campaign
